name: LinkGraph Notes
tagline: AI-native Markdown vault & interactive knowledge graph — local-first Markdown vault & interactive graph inside Anna AI OS.
description: Turn scattered Markdown notes into a connected, searchable knowledge graph inside Anna AI OS. Features bidirectional [[wiki-links]], interactive canvas graph navigation, deterministic orphan/broken-link diagnostics, one-click unlinked mention discovery, persistent per-user vault storage, and built-in AI summaries & action-item extraction with zero external API keys required.
